meta.title: Raimov System | RAIMOV DENTAL
meta.description: Patient-facing explanation of Raimov System — eight steps from diagnostics to follow-up.
meta.author: Atabek Raimov

intro.heading: Raimov System
intro.body: Raimov System is not a single procedure. It is the pathway for a complex case: from diagnostics and case conference to a staged plan and follow-up.
intro.excludes: No franchise, royalty, or ELITE DENTAL commercial content on this site.

steps.title: Diagnostic data collection
steps.description: Clinical exam, photo protocol, digital scanning, and imaging when indicated.
steps.patientOutcome: You understand the baseline and constraints

steps.title: Outcome design
steps.description: Digital planning of smile and function with aligned expectations.
steps.patientOutcome: You align on the outcome direction before treatment starts

steps.title: Team review
steps.description: Specialists assess options and risks before the final plan.
steps.patientOutcome: You get a team decision, not scattered advice

steps.title: Treatment sequence
steps.description: Clear route: what happens first and what follows.
steps.patientOutcome: You see the stage order on one map

steps.title: Staged budget
steps.description: Staged estimate without hidden steps. Exact amounts are agreed after diagnostics.
steps.patientOutcome: You know amounts are finalised after diagnostics

steps.title: Specialist coordination
steps.description: One plan with owners at each stage.
steps.patientOutcome: You know who owns each stage

steps.title: Quality control
steps.description: Bite, aesthetics, and function checks at key milestones.

steps.title: Long-term follow-up
steps.description: Control visit schedule and care guidance after major stages.
steps.patientOutcome: You leave with a follow-up plan after core stages
